openQuestions.title: Explain or eliminate the aborted html-stream request
openQuestions.detail: Driving Start stream leaves net::ERR_ABORTED for /v151/renewed-html-insertion-streaming-methods/html-stream?chunks=6&delay=200 while the chunk log completes normally — likely the reader cancelling the tail, but it reads as a failed request in devtools; either consume the stream fully or note the deliberate cancel.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: started a 6-chunk/200ms stream from the real server route; chunks rendered incrementally with honest fallback labelling; zero console errors but one ERR_ABORTED on the stream fetch worth explaining.
